decision_table.name: Determine_OR_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Oregon state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in OR (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
OR filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
A corporation has physical presence nexus in Oregon if it has: - An office, warehouse, or other place of business in Oregon - Employees working in Oregon - Tangible personal property located in Oregon - Real property located in Oregon
Reference: ORS 317.010-317.665 (Corporation Excise Tax) Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Filing requirements) Reference: Oregon Department of Revenue Corporate Income Tax Guide

OR filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Economic nexus threshold: $750,000 in Oregon sales (higher than the typical $100,000 threshold).
Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), Oregon requires filing if a corporation exceeds economic nexus thresholds, even without physical presence.
Oregon uses a higher economic nexus threshold ($750,000) compared to most states that use $100,000 or $500,000 thresholds.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Oregon Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance Reference: ORS 317.010 (Definitions and nexus standards)

No OR nexus - no filing requirement.
Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. Any estimated payments would be refunded.
Reference: ORS 317.010 (Nexus requirements)

decision_table.name: Calculate_OR_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate OR state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
OR state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
OR ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: - Interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to OR) - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback (OR conformity varies) - State income tax refunds included in federal income - Bonus depreciation addback (OR may decouple from federal accelerated depreciation) - Expenses related to income exempt from Oregon tax
OR SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: - Interest on Oregon state and municipal bonds (exempt for OR purposes) - Oregon net operating loss deduction (subject to OR limitations) - Dividends from certain subsidiaries (subject to ownership requirements) - Federal income taxes paid (to extent included in federal taxable income)
Reference: Oregon Form 20 Schedule OR-ASC (Additions and Subtractions) Reference: ORS 317.267 (Oregon taxable income determination) Reference: Oregon Department of Revenue Publication 17-118 (Federal tax changes)

No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.
Corporation does not have OR nexus, so no income adjustments are needed.

decision_table.name: Calculate_OR_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate OR state corporate excise tax. Applies OR 6.6% flat rate (7.6% for financial institutions) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income, then ensures minimum tax is met.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

condition.name: is_financial_institution
condition.comment: Is financial institution subject to 7.6% rate

rule.policy:
OR state corporate excise tax calculation (FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS):
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to OR: × [Single-sales apportionment %] 3. OR additions: + [Federal interest, 199A addback, etc.] 4. OR subtractions: - [OR municipal interest, OR NOL, etc.] 5. OR taxable income: = [Result] 6. OR tax rate: × 7.6% (FINANCIAL INSTITUTION RATE) 7. OR excise tax: = [Tax before minimum] 8. OR minimum tax: = [Based on Oregon sales - see ORS 317.090] 9. OR tax before credits: = MAX(excise tax, minimum tax) 10. OR credits: - [Film, renewable energy, business expansion credits] 11. OR tax liability: = MAX(minimum tax, tax - credits)
Note: Credits cannot reduce tax below the minimum tax amount.
Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return) Reference: ORS 317.061(2) (Financial institution tax rate - 7.6%) Reference: ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax schedule) Reference: ORS 317.267 (Single-sales factor apportionment)

OR state corporate excise tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to OR: × [Single-sales apportionment %] 3. OR additions: + [Federal interest, 199A addback, state tax refunds, etc.] 4. OR subtractions: - [OR municipal interest, OR NOL, qualified dividends, etc.] 5. OR taxable income: = [Result] 6. OR tax rate: × 6.6% (flat rate for regular corporations) 7. OR excise tax: = [Tax before minimum] 8. OR minimum tax: = [Based on Oregon sales - see schedule below] 9. OR tax before credits: = MAX(excise tax, minimum tax) 10. OR credits: - [Film, renewable energy, business expansion, etc.] 11. OR tax liability: = MAX(minimum tax, tax - credits)
CRITICAL: Credits cannot reduce tax below the minimum tax amount.
Oregon Minimum Tax Schedule (ORS 317.090): - Less than $500,000 in OR sales: $150 - $500,000 to $999,999: $500 - $1 million to $1.999 million: $1,000 - $2 million to $2.999 million: $1,500 - $3 million to $4.999 million: $2,000 - $5 million to $6.999 million: $4,000 - $7 million to $9.999 million: $7,500 - $10 million to $24.999 million: $15,000 - $25 million to $49.999 million: $30,000 - $50 million to $74.999 million: $50,000 - $75 million to $99.999 million: $75,000 - $100 million or more: $100,000
Oregon provides various tax credits including: - Film and video production credit - Renewable energy development credit - Business expansion credit - Housing development credit
Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return) Reference: ORS 317.061(1) (Tax rate - 6.6%) Reference: ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax schedule) Reference: ORS 317.267 (Single-sales factor apportionment) Reference: Oregon Department of Revenue Corporate Tax Credits Guide

No OR nexus - no tax liability.
Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in OR. Any estimated payments are refunded.
Reference: ORS 317.010 (Nexus requirements)

No OR taxable income - but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES.
Corporation has OR nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. However, Oregon MINIMUM TAX is still required based on Oregon sales.
CRITICAL: Even with no taxable income or a loss, corporations with Oregon nexus must pay the minimum tax. The minimum tax ranges from $150 to $100,000 based on Oregon sales.
Oregon net operating loss (NOL) rules: - Oregon allows NOL carryforward - Carryback rules vary by tax year - NOL does not eliminate minimum tax requirement
Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return) Reference: ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax - applies regardless of income) Reference: ORS 317.476 (Net operating loss deduction)
